title: Department of Energy: Phase 56O Remediation Follow-Through
summary: GAO reports that DOE implemented five of thirty prior priority recommendations, added one priority recommendation, removed priority status from two, and now has twenty-four priority recommendations. Phase 56O decision: Publish the exact portfolio movement while keeping implemented, newly added, de-prioritized, and currently prioritized states distinct.
key_findings: Exact record: GAO-26-109001 DOE priority recommendation portfolio.
Status period: April 2025 baseline through July 2026.
Continuation rule: Reopen when GAO publishes the next DOE priority letter or changes a named current recommendation status.
why_it_matters: The record exposes implementation throughput and remaining remediation workload without converting a portfolio into a performance rate.
ftfn_relevance: Keeps implemented, added, de-prioritized, current, modeled, and realized states distinct.
Attaches source, period, scope, limitation, remaining gap, and continuation rule.
evidence_limits: The letter reports portfolio movement and priority areas, not the status of every recommendation or a measure of department performance, safety, readiness, or value.
Action-level identities and closure evidence for the current twenty-four, including DOE insider-threat recommendations 1 and 7 and the separate AI-inventory action.
No ranking, composite, readiness score, performance rate, or causal claim is supported.
